response.text: According to a recent wholesale report, fresh bananas in the United States were priced at **$28.50 USD per carton (40 lb)** as of April 11, 2025, and over the past four weeks, U.S. wholesale banana prices have typically ranged between **$1.24 and $3.75 USD per kg** (or **$0.56 to $1.70 per pound**).
